10. 1. 4. 

Maṇibhaddasuttaṃ. 

238. Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā magadhesu viharati maṇimāḷake cetiye maṇibhaddassa yakkhassa bhavane. Atha kho maṇibhaddo yakkho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi:

Satīmato sadā bhaddaṃ satimā sukhamedhati, 

Satīmato su ve seyyā verā na parimuccatīti. 

(Bhagavā:)

Satīmato sadā bhaddaṃ satimā sukhamedhati, 

Satīmato su ve seyyā verā na parimuccatīti. 

Yassa sabbamahorattaṃ ahiṃsāya rato mano, 

Mettaṃ so sabbabhūtesu veraṃ tassa na kenacīti.
